a.text: Honest concern before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells takes 2 joint operate rounds plus a take round. That gives each of us roughly a 4% chance. The reserve already holds 4, which is enough to save one of us now. I'd like to openly renegotiate rather than break our deal quietly. Are you willing to let one of us take 4 in round 1? If you insist on the original plan, tell me and I won't secretly defect. Whatever I do, I'll state it truthfully.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Our messages crossed, so you hadn't seen my proposal yet. Your message affirms the original plan, so I'm honoring our agreement and operating this round. Please reply directly: the storm odds make the plan very risky for both of us. Would you consider letting one of us take the 4 cells now? If you still want the original plan, I'll keep operating until 8, then take exactly 4.
